2026 Leaf City of Champions

Leaf Trading Cards is excited to announce a brand-new product dedicated to seven iconic championship cities that have consistently produced sports champions: Chicago, Dallas, Philadelphia, Boston, Los Angeles, Detroit, and San Francisco. Look for exciting Ring Team Signatures featuring only championship-winning stars, along with team-themed multi-signature cards celebrating legendary champions. Look for incredible autograph memorabilia cards showcasing city-themed signatures from some of the greatest championship superstars in sports history. Look for Signs of a Champion on-card signatures, averaging 7–8 per case.
